title: Approximate tangent planes and tangential differentials along C¹ charts (Simon Remarks 1.5(2), 1.8(1); Ch. 2 (4.8)-(4.10))
statement: Let n, ℓ, p ∈ ℕ, N = n + ℓ. Let M ⊆ ℝ^N be Hⁿ-measurable, θ a positive locally integrable weight on M (θ > 0 on M, θ is Hⁿ⌞M-measurable, ∫_{M∩K} θ dHⁿ < ∞ for every compact K), U ⊇ M open, f : ℝ^N → ℝᵖ locally Lipschitz on U, V ⊆ ℝⁿ open and ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^N of class C¹ on V with injective derivative Dψ(u) at every u ∈ V. Then for Lⁿ-a.e. u ∈ V with ψ(u) ∈ M: (A) M has approximate tangent space range Dψ(u) at ψ(u) with respect to θ in the sense of Simon's Definition 1.7 (HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt); (B) f ∘ ψ is differentiable at u; (C) for every w ∈ ℝⁿ, t ↦ f(ψ(u) + t·Dψ(u)w) has derivative D(f∘ψ)(u)w at t = 0 (HasLineDerivAt).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ p : ℕ) (M U : Set (Rn (n + ℓ))) (θ : Rn (n + ℓ) → ℝ) (f : Rn (n + ℓ) → Rn p) (V : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn (n + ℓ)), NullMeasurableSet M μHE[n] → IsPositiveLocallyIntegrableWeight n M θ → IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → LocallyLipschitzOn U f → IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V → (∀ u ∈ V, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ u)) → ∀ᵐ u ∂(volume : Measure (Rn n)), u ∈ V → ψ u ∈ M → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ (ψ u) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ u).toLinearMap) ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ (f ∘ ψ) u ∧ ∀ w : Rn n, HasLineDerivAt ℝ f (fderiv ℝ (f ∘ ψ) u w) (ψ u) (fderiv ℝ ψ u w)
